opening.argument: The speaker describes a paid opportunity tied directly to Bitcoin earnings, saying the network costs “like 500” and that participants were “getting one bitcoin” for a cycle when Bitcoin was $200. He reinforces that pitch with claims that members are purchasing Range Rovers, big houses, and traveling the world, then urges the audience, “So don't wait, work now!” Taken together, the joining cost, Bitcoin-linked earnings, conspicuous wealth claims, and immediate call to action present an affirmative solicitation to participate in the paid mining business, not neutral market commentary.
